title: I Built an AI powered Material Generator
author: ajdare
selftext: You can create any kind of material in any style with the help of AI image generating, then it's processed by Tileset forge to automatically handle things like transparency, reflection, metallic (etc) [https://sorceress.games/pages/material-forge](https://sorceress.games/pages/material-forge)
